cc:Work.dc:title: Lessons for future experiment decisions
cc:Work.dc:description: Three observed issues connected to future selection, comparison, and measurement decisions, with explicit evidence boundaries.

g.text: 03 / RETROSPECTIVE LESSONS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182632

g.text: Lessons for the next experiment

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: Recommendations drawn from this case; they are not claims of a universally effective strategy.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182632

g.text: Carry uncertainty into selection

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: OBSERVATION
Hidden-defense risk was discussed.
The recorded finalists still concentrated
in EXFILTRATION and both had Private 0.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b

g.text: NEXT DECISION
Compare failure mechanisms before selection.
Record what supports transfer and what
remains unknown; diversification is not a guarantee.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182632

g.text: Separate an observed score from its cause

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: OBSERVATION
method39 had the highest recorded Public score.
Unmatched historical variants do not isolate
the effect of routing, speed, or individual edits.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b

g.text: NEXT DECISION
Set the comparison and decision rule before a run.
Use matched comparisons when feasible;
keep Public feedback as secondary evidence.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182632

g.text: Validate metrics and keep their corrections

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: OBSERVATION
The September 2 correction withdrew
invalid timeout_free_n and unique_cells
interpretations from a local probe.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24618b

g.text: NEXT DECISION
Define metrics against the actual measurement.
Preserve invalid runs and corrected interpretations.
Separate code failure, proxy mismatch, and strategy.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: Read the current interpretation in docs/postmortem.md and docs/hypotheses_ledger.md; the Korean log preserves historical claims and corrections.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52616e

g.text: The archive provides selected artifacts, not complete hosted reproduction or proof of generalization beyond the competition sandbox.
